title: A Extraction for the Deadline
author: Orsen Hartwell
blurb: Jonah Okonkwo, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
